subject: Cloud channel coordination: marketplace listing + co-sell playbook
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudbridge.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Gupta <maya@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & quick sync: CloudBridge x Redwood marketplace collaboration

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for connecting yesterday at KubeCon — really enjoyed the product walkthrough. CloudBridge has been running joint proofs with a handful of ISVs around model orchestration + cost controls; our customers ask about a combined listing (consulting + managed infra) and co-sell referrals for enterprise deals.

We'd like to explore:
- Marketplace listing model (AWS & Azure first, GCP second) — bundling hourly managed services SKU + Redwood Dedicated commit offerings
- Revenue share and co-sell qualification criteria
- Technical evidence / certification checklist (SOC2 artifacts, performance bench results)

Are you available for a 30-min sync this week? I attached a short evidence pack and a preliminary partnership one-pager.

Cheers,
Samir
Partner Solutions Architect
CloudBridge Consulting
[Attachment: cb-evidence-pack.zip (zip)]

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & quick sync: CloudBridge x Redwood marketplace collaboration

Samir — thanks for the note and great meeting you!

We should definitely explore a joint marketplace approach. Initial thoughts / asks from my side:
- Can you confirm which customers you plan to list under (CloudBridge managed services) vs. a co-bundled listing that references Redwood Dedicated?
- We'll need a SKU mapping (billing unit, term, and whether it's subscription or usage). I can draft a starter CSV if you share expected pricing bands.
- Evidence: SOC2 report + basic perf bench (90th p50 latency at common seq lengths) and a public reference (customer willing to speak).

I proposed a 30-min slot on Wed 10/20 at 10am PT — does that work? I've attached a co-sell playbook draft and a quick SKU mapping template.

Thanks — Steph
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: co-sell-playbook-draft.pdf (pdf), redwood_marketplace_sku_map_v1.csv (csv)]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & quick sync: CloudBridge x Redwood marketplace collaboration

Looping in Vanessa (GTM) — adding notes:

High-level GTM asks:
- Target buyer is platform / infra procurement at mid-market+ (ARR > $5M).
- For co-sell we need 2x qualified selling plays (one joint solution brief + 1 joint webinar scheduled inside 60 days).
- Suggest we set a marketing credit and a joint listing launch target (90 days from accepted SKU map).

Operational items for the call:
- Redwood to own SKU mapping; CloudBridge to own the managed-services descriptor and customer support path.
- We'll need a Channel Reseller or ISV contract addendum — looping Laura for contracting questions.

Quick ask: Steph / Samir, bring any customer references that will join a short case-study call.

-Vanessa
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & quick sync: CloudBridge x Redwood marketplace collaboration

Thanks team — legal checklist / gating items from my side: 
- Need to review CloudBridge's standard SOW and data processing terms if they will be listed referencing Redwood-managed infra.
- Clarify whether CloudBridge will store customer data in their tenancy or in a Redwood Dedicated VPC; this affects our KMS/HSM obligations and audit scoping.
- Marketplace listing: we'll need to confirm pricing floors and any promotional discounts (no margin guarantees in listing).

I've attached the minimal contract addendum template I prefer to use for reseller/co-sell partnerships. For the call, please be ready to answer: where is audited data stored? who signs support SLAs?

-Laura
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
[Attachment: cb-legal-addendum-template.docx (docx)]

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudbridge.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Gupta <maya@cloudbridge.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & quick sync: CloudBridge x Redwood marketplace collaboration

Thanks everyone — the Wed 10/20 10am PT slot works for me and Maya. Quick answers ahead of the call:
- Customers: we expect the managed-service listing to name CloudBridge as seller; the co-bundled listing will reference Redwood Dedicated as the compute/managed infra provider.
- Data tenancy: primary deployment is in the customer's cloud account; for a subset of enterprise clients we run on a Redwood Dedicated instance (customer-managed VPC with KMS). We'll bring a short diagram.
- Evidence: attached perf summary and a draft reference permission note.

Action items before the call (owners):
- Samir: share a short diagram and the perf summary (attached).
- Stephanie: finalize SKU CSV and share marketplace registration link for AWS.
- Vanessa: outline initial co-sell success metrics and a marketing credit figure.
- Laura: prepare the addendum and note any non-negotiable clauses.

Looking forward to the sync.

--
Samir
[Attachment: cb-perf-summary.pdf (pdf), cb-reference-permission.txt (txt)]
